 Order
Learned counsel for the appellant has filed a memo seeking permission of this Court to withdraw the appeal as the same is settled out of Court.
2. The memo is placed on record.
3. The appeal is dismissed as settled out of the Court.
4. Amount in deposit, if any, is ordered to be refunded to the appellant on due identification.
5. In view of the dismissal of the appeal, pending applications, if any, do not survive for consideration and the same are disposed of accordingly.
